Done. Read-only design + regression authoring complete.

## SP08-D3 residuals — concrete outcomes + design

**Authored (no production edits):** `internal/daemon/prompt_order_v6_test.go`, `internal/observer/derived_publication_v6_test.go`, `plans/sdd/V6-remediation/prompt-order-publication-design.md`. gofmt/vet clean. I did not read the other author's in-flight `delivery_lease`/`seal`/`archive`/rollover designs — only the shipped `deliveryLease.ArrivalSeq`/`ObservationID` that `publishCapture` already consumes.

**Test outcomes (run after the gate appeared; real subprocess exit codes, no pipe masking):**
- `internal/daemon TestPromptOrder_V6_*` — **exit 0 (PASS)**, pinning issue 1: with P0 leased at arrival N ("first") and P1 at N+1 ("second"), publishing P1 first makes `prompt_<s>_0 == "second"` (later arrival takes turn 0), and a second test pins that an unleased-earlier spooled prompt cannot claim turn 0 (the separate, unprovable-order boundary). `dist/v6-remediation/prompt-order-daemon.log`.
- `internal/observer TestDerivedPublication_V6_IndexBeforeLinkCutDuplicatesAcrossRestart` — **exit 1 (FAIL)** at line 77: after an index-before-link cut and restart, `subagent_<s>_1` exists → the derived capture duplicated. This is the intended failing regression (correct-assertion), flips GREEN when fixed. `dist/v6-remediation/prompt-order-derived-observer.log`.

**Design (smallest compatible fixes; main owns implementation & shared durable-data decisions):**
- **Issue 1** — endorse main's **fail-closed dispatch**: refuse to publish arrival A of session S while A−1 is leased-but-unacknowledged (nonblocking, WAL stays pending, retry via existing re-drain). Belongs at the **dispatch layer** (`ingest.dispatch`/drain), not `runIngested`. Bounded memory (one int/active session). With in-arrival-order publication, `PromptFrontier`'s `next` == arrival order → no `PromptFrontier` change. **Claim only "in-order among leased arrivals"** — the spooled-but-unleased earlier prompt is an unprovable coverage boundary, not something the fix closes.
- **Issue 2** — endorse main's **versioned publication-intent record for derived IDs**, written/fsynced before the index record, keyed by `ObservationID`, recognized on redelivery *before* `freeDerivedTurn`. Not `ArgsDigest` (real tool-arg content; O(index) scan) and not the `Published` sidecar fields (that's the after-record join; intent is a before-record reservation). It must durably advance a per-session derived-turn frontier so reserved-but-unpublished turns read occupied to concurrent captures and to a restart (the derived analogue of `PromptFrontier`, which already counts `SubagentStop` turns). Bounded, fail-closed-when-absent, exactly-once claimed only to tested cuts.

No commits, no config/auth changes, no release signoff — implementation awaits your decision; the two regressions are the acceptance criteria.
